definition: Jarosław Królewski ([jaˈrɔswaf kruˈlɛfskʲi]; born September 26, 1986) is a Polish entrepreneur, programmer, sociologist, investor, and philanthropist from Hańczowa, Poland.
details: He is a researcher and lecturer at the AGH University of Krakow. He was selected as a Young Global Leader by the World Economic Forum in 2025. Królewski is a cofounder and chief executive of the software development company Synerise - behavioral Artificial intelligence infrastructure. He is also the president and a majority stakeholder of the Polish soccer club Wisła Kraków. He has served as an advisor to the Prime Minister of Poland - Donald Tusk (Future Council) and to the President of Poland (Business Council) - Karol Nawrocki since 2026.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Jarosław Królewski — a small key that opens a big door.
